shipped_rows.title_o: Coupling spectral unmixing and trend analysis for monitoring of long-term vegetation dynamics in Mediterranean rangelands
shipped_rows.outcome_quote: Results differed fundamentally because the volatile timing of statically selected images relative to the phenological cycle introduced systematic uncertainty.

parent_scope_objection: Second and final review; no attempt reset. Initial failed verdict dismisses VD1as solely baseline, but current two-phase study explicitly reports thematic recovery of Hostert42andSonnenschein49under reconstructed static-selectionVD1, then reverses trends under seasonally controlledVD2and centrally argues the earlier method produces spurious vegetation trends. Read whole main message: determine statistically successful but flawed versus mixed versus failed, separating reproduction of the old result using its method from new-sample alternative-method validity criticism. Expanded spatial/temporal satellite observations are not identical-original numerical recovery; do not equate unavailable original numbers with failure of the original thematic result. Both original-specific phases and author methodological interpretation must be addressed. Actual ambiguity stays explicit if codebook/evidence cannot settle it.
